description.value: Kingston Hotel is a family-run, century-old budget boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Vancouver, describing itself as Vancouver's Best Budget Boutique Hotel. The 25-room property offers a mix of private and shared-bathroom rooms, an on-site sauna, and a business centre, appealing to travellers seeking affordable accommodation steps from major city attractions. Its central Richards Street location puts a touring cyclist within easy reach of the seawall, transit, and urban amenities.

bike_parking_detail: 11 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 45m; stands (4 spaces) at 51m; stands (8 spaces) at 52m; stands (2 spaces) at 71m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 73m; stands (4 spaces) at 75m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 77m; stands (2 spaces) at 85m; stands (4 spaces) at 91m; stands (2 spaces) at 95m; stands (2 spaces) at 96m. Total: 44 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, open budget boutique hotel at the OSM address (757 Richards St) with a live 2026 booking system and FIFA World Cup 2026 promotional content. The gallery/amenities page lists 'Amenities Laundry' as a distinct photo, confirming laundry facilities on-site. No bike storage, bike procedures, or any cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; the sauna and business centre are the only non-room amenities described.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible hotel confirmed open via a live booking system and current promotional content. A valid accommodation option for touring cyclists visiting downtown Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone number appears in OSM tags and the hotel email is listed in OSM, but neither is displayed in the scraped website text, so phone confirmation is inconclusive. Website content was largely navigation/boilerplate with limited amenity detail; a fuller amenity page may exist but was not captured.
